doctrine: ads8: five spec ads (grok, zai, moonshot, claude, claudecode), ads7 grammar: absurd open, plain model, visual quirk never narrated, mouths closed, centre-square composition, guard verbatim
guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit. Composed for a centered square crop: every story object stays inside the middle third of the frame and never approaches the left or right edge.

zai.positioning: Zhipu's open frontier GLM models for builders, high-end coding and reasoning at cost-efficient prices (verified: z.ai, docs.z.ai, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
zai.quirk: the coffee mug never moves an inch through the whole expansion, steamless and steady
zai.bed: warm minimal tech pulse with soft piano, instrumental
zai.narration: Your studio apartment is smaller than the problem you're solving. Z.ai puts frontier open models in anyone's hands, the same weights the big labs guard, priced for builders. Build like the room was never small.
zai.closer: Z.ai, frontier open models priced for builders. Start building tonight. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
zai.look_prompt: She sits at a minimal light-wood desk in a small bright studio apartment, facing the camera at a slight angle, wearing a relaxed sage-green shirt over a white top, hair in a low ponytail, minimal natural makeup, focused warm expression. A closed silver laptop and a ceramic mug sit at rest on the desk, morning light from a side window, a small plant on a shelf behind. She is not mid-action with any object. Nothing held, everything at rest.

scenes.a: Behind {character}, typing, walls shoot backward and the ceiling rockets up within one second. Empty workstation rows blaze with blank white screens into warehouse depth. Once architecture settles, pull back and rise briskly: whole desktop visible, face 15% of frame height, existing mug at two-thirds height. Desk and steamless mug remain fixed. End camera at rest. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: From the inherited wide, blank workstation screens brighten in a fast wave toward the far wall behind {character}. Skylight fills the enormous roof and empty aisles. Then crane slightly higher without approaching; retain the whole desktop and clearly outlined, stationary steamless mug at two-thirds height. Every workstation is empty. End on the luminous warehouse at rest. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: From the high wide, lower slightly while {character} keeps typing beside the stationary steamless mug. Empty workstations have blank glowing screens. Stop the camera before the final two seconds: rows retract rapidly and walls snap home behind the unchanged desk, restoring the desk lamp left, bookshelf above and white fridge right. End in the original studio. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.d: From the restored studio wide, {character} types with new certainty; tense shoulders finally drop. Hold this distance and elevation, the whole desktop visible and the untouched steamless mug outlined at two-thirds height. The desk lamp left, bookshelf above and white fridge right crowd the same small room. End with typing continuing, hands never reaching for the mug. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

props: a ceramic mug on the desk beside the keyboard
